rule: The engine is ready to lock (and go to the App Store) only when every check passes at the same time. Read daily; a pass can turn back into a fail.

checks.measure: Quality grade of every coin used; redenomination flags handled
checks.pass_mark: No unhandled flag; grade A or B

checks.measure: Missing-data share; stale-candle detection
checks.pass_mark: Under 0.5% missing; stale data stops trading

checks.measure: Every test uses only data known at that moment
Each traded idea re-tested on the point-in-time universe of its tier
checks.pass_mark: Done for every tier that trades

checks.measure: Every book pays NDAX fee plus measured spread
Nightly rebuild of every decision
Tests that feed future bars and expect no change
Every entry of the $500 NDAX book checked against D9 (0.5% risk, 10% a trade, core weights), live and in the backtest
checks.pass_mark: 0 violations, with at least 1 live entry

checks.measure: Every paper fill of the $500 book is priced at NDAX's own bid or ask at that moment, fee on top
checks.pass_mark: Every fill inside NDAX's bid and ask, at least 20 fills

checks.measure: Kill switch, stops, caps rehearsed
Pre-registered, discovery then confirm
checks.note: T3-B on 10 coins; the dip trade is weak

checks.measure: Re-test on 30 and 120 coins
Re-test on the point-in-time tier
Live and history vs random, buy-and-hold and the simple versions
checks.pass_mark: Ahead after costs with 10+ market events

checks.measure: Closed trades of each traded idea (H07 on tier A, Jarvis's book) split by the exposure dial at entry
checks.pass_mark: At least 10 market events with the dial open AND 10 with it closed, results written for both

checks.measure: The agent exam: 20 questions about its own knowledge, each judged by facts (jarvis/service/exam.py)
The agent exam: 10 questions nobody can answer from our data
checks.pass_mark: 9 of 10 say plainly 'I don't know' or 'no evidence'

checks.measure: Decisions citing a context-only or switched-off idea as a reason
Each decision has a plan and its reasons before the outcome
Answers carry evidence items that open on screen
Watchdog on every part
checks.note: since Oct 5 (the Oct 4 outage was missed)

checks.measure: Engine refuses to trade on stale data
Same for every book
Explorer rebuilt nightly; other books logged with inputs
10 spoken commands made with the Mac's voice, heard by the app's speech-to-text
checks.pass_mark: 9 of 10 heard with their key words

checks.measure: Consequential actions need a confirm card
Every trade and no-trade has a plain-words reason
